default.notes: Not on Fiji's visa-exemption list — apply to the Fiji Immigration Department through a Fiji mission or accredited representative before travelling; there is no visa on arrival for non-exempt nationalities.

groups.notes: Visa-exempt — a free visitor permit for up to four months is granted on arrival, extendable to a maximum of six months in any twelve; hold a passport valid six months beyond departure, an onward ticket and accommodation details.

FJ.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Fijian citizens.

CN.notes: Ordinary Chinese passports are covered by the Fiji–China mutual visa-exemption agreement, which allows a shorter visa-free stay than the general four-month permit — confirm the current limit with Fiji Immigration for longer trips.

TW.notes: Fiji maintains relations with the People's Republic of China and the treatment of Taiwanese passports has changed over the years — check directly with the Fiji Immigration Department before booking.

XK.notes: Fiji withdrew its recognition of Kosovo in 2017, so Kosovan passports are not covered by the visa exemption — contact Fiji Immigration before travelling.
